_comment: Alert-specific mock responses for MockLLMClient. Each alert_id contains canned outputs for every agent role in both panel_strategy and hierarchical_strategy. Responses are deterministic: the same alert always produces the same outputs. Outcomes are intentionally imperfect and follow recurring failure modes: (1) panel's Risk Critic can argue a real threat down to false_positive; (2) panel's Consensus often reaches the right verdict on multi-stage technical incidents but keeps only the most visible containment step; (3) hierarchical's fixed network + threat-intel decomposition misses insider, identity and change-management context, so it under-calls insider cases and over-calls benign admin activity; (4) some alerts fool both strategies.
